name: Pointer Pull
description: A wrapper that lets whatever is inside drift toward a nearby pointer and spring back when it leaves.

props.name: children
props.description: The control to move, usually one Button or IconButton.

props.name: strength
props.description: Fraction of the distance from the centre to the pointer that the child travels.

props.name: maxDistance
props.description: Furthest the child moves, in pixels. The pull reaches twice this far beyond the edges and fades out toward the limit.

props.name: inner
props.description: Move the child's contents a little further than its shell, so the label seems to float inside.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. Other span props are passed through. There is no movement on touch screens or with reduced motion.
